# beehiiv Connector for Muse

💳 Paid API required: this connector needs a paid third-party API — the listing is free, but usage is billed. See Prerequisites for costs.

A Muse agent skill that reads and writes your beehiiv newsletters: list publications, list subscribers, list posts with stats, and add subscribers. Adding a subscriber is a write — the skill confirms the email and publication first; reading needs no confirmation. Honest note: the beehiiv API requires a Scale plan or higher with an Owner or Admin role, and rate-limits to 180 requests per minute. Draft: written from beehiiv's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
